entities.summary: Jake Bean is a Canadian professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Calgary Flames of the National Hockey League (NHL). Bean was drafted in the first round, 13th overall in the 2016 NHL Entry Draft by the Carolina Hurricanes.
